# markvis

Open-source library. A fence in Markdown is the chart. Same text, same SVG. No plugin, the table still shows.

Fetch this file. Emit a fence. Do not invent fields.

## Fence

Tags `chart`, `markvis`, and `vis` are the same language.

Order:

1. Optional `markvis: 2`
2. One `key: value` per line
3. Blank line
4. Data: CSV, or one GFM table

Fields:

- `type` required. Only `bar` `line` `area` `scatter` `pie` `hist`.
- `title` optional. A conclusion, not a slug.
- `theme` optional. Omit means `folio`. Allowed: `folio` `highcharts` `shadcn` `docs` `ant`. Any other value is `E_UNKNOWN_THEME`: show the table, not a silent swap.
- `unit` optional.
- `x` `y` `series` name real columns. `series` splits series.
- Data required. Not JSON.

Also valid: an HTML comment immediately followed by a GFM table.

`<!-- chart: bar x=month y=revenue title="Feb led Q3 at 180" -->`

Comment keys: `type` (required), `x`, `y`, `title`, `unit`, `series`. Same meaning as fence headers.

## Types

- `bar` — category x, number y. Keep row order. Do not sort.
- `line` — ordered x, number y. Optional `series`. Keep row order.
- `area` — same as line, filled.
- `scatter` — number x, number y. One mark per row.
- `pie` — label x, number y >= 0. Do not force the slices to 100.
- `hist` — number x. Table keeps the raw rows.

On any error: keep the rows, show the table, add one line with the error code. Never drop the numbers.

## Copy these

### Bar

```chart
markvis: 2
type: bar
title: Feb led Q3 at 180
unit: USD k
x: month
y: revenue

month,revenue
Jan,120
Feb,180
Mar,150
```

### Line

```chart
type: line
title: Free still leads pro
x: month
y: count
series: plan

month,plan,count
Jan,free,40
Jan,pro,12
Feb,free,55
Feb,pro,18
```

### Pie

```markvis
type: pie
title: A leads at 40
x: name
y: value

name,value
A,40
B,35
C,30
```

Emit the fence. Do not emit a PNG. Do not add a seventh type.
